title: One Review window for every project

options.label: Its own single Review window
options.act: Singleton Window('Review'); opened from menu bar, notifications, widget, ⌘⇧R
options.then: Make one Review window for every project, opened from the menu bar, notifications and the widget.

options.label: A section of the main window

why: This replaces round one's "every project in one inbox". It's a single window (Window("Review", id: "review")), like Mail's All Inboxes or Xcode's Organizer, not a page inside the main window: the main window stays the place things run. The menu-bar count, the notifications and the widget all open here.

Inside it, every project's Needs you in one list, grouped by project and sorted by what blocks an agent first. Pick a project on the left to narrow it down. That's Superhuman's split inbox across projects.
